s: Company Description: US Music counts Bob Dylan among buyers of its pricey custom-made guitars. For the less lofty, the company produces and imports mass-market acoustic and electric guitars at prices of up to $3,000. One of the US's top guitar makers (behind Fender, Gibson, and Martin), US Music also makes banjos, mandolins, and basses under the Washburn name.
